_comment: Tier-2: DISPLACEMENT is the structural DOF; ROTATION must be added additionally for beams and shells. Pitfall (kratos.linear_elasticity #4). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The claim's precise part is verified: creating CrBeamElement3D2N with only DISPLACEMENT added succeeds AND elem.Initialize(ProcessInfo) does NOT raise; the failure appears only at the first GetSolutionStepValue(ROTATION_X), as RuntimeError 'This container only can store the variables specified in its variables list. The variables list doesn't have this variable:ROTATION_X'. Adding ROTATION makes the same read return 0.0. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 builds the beam model part WITH ROTATION added, the documented correct thing, so the first ROTATION_X read succeeds instead of raising. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: rotation_read_raised=True, observed=variables_list_container_error, beam_rotation_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/beam_requires_rotation_variable && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
